## How Creators Earn Money on CurseForge

Overwolf runs a points-based reward program for mod authors. Points accumulate based on a project’s popularity across the CurseForge website and desktop client, though there is no fixed “X downloads equals Y points” conversion. A popularity threshold must be reached before a project generates any points at all, and that threshold is kept internal. Each point is worth $0.05. ⁶ CurseForge. [Reward Program FAQ](https://support.curseforge.com/en/support/solutions/articles/9000197902-reward-program-faq)

Creators can cash out their points as PayPal deposits, Payoneer transfers, or Amazon gift cards. PayPal and Payoneer orders are typically processed within the first few days of each month.

## Intellectual Property Rights for Mod Authors

Mod authors keep ownership of their work when they upload to CurseForge. The platform does not claim title to your mods. However, by submitting a mod, you grant Overwolf a broad, worldwide, [royalty-free license](https://legalclarity.org/what-does-royalty-free-mean-and-how-does-it-work/) to use, store, reproduce, distribute, modify, and create [derivative works](https://legalclarity.org/what-is-a-derivative-work-under-copyright-law/) from it. ⁹ Overwolf. World of Warcraft Forums

# Curseforge transfer marking projects as "abandoned"

Guides UI and Macro

[Bluspacecow-muradin](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Bluspacecow-muradin) (Bluspacecow) December 1, 2020, 8:18am 1

Heads up to addon authors.

Now that the site freeze is over and the migration to Overwolf hardware is pretty much done you may see a message on your projects saying your project is abandoned and no longer maintained.

You’ll see this message if didn’t consent to transfer your user information from Twitch so they’ve been flagged as abandoned.

How to restore -

* Fill in the [Restore Curseforge Account form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScYgFUcBZQ-k9R7mSl5lmVIiQCh-G72BPchD1s-LJZhhI61Gw/viewform)
* Wait for the Curseforge team to process it
* Any issues ? Here’s the [Curseforge Discord](https://discord.gg/Xddcj4X6nk)

The transfer process should be pretty quick , assuming someone from the Curseforge team is awake.
For example SimulationCraft had the abandoned message. The Overwolf twitter advised them of the form 2 hours ago. Their abadoned flag has since been removed.

1 Like

[[CS Lounge] Holidays in Shadowland](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/cs-lounge-holidays-in-shadowland/728432/361)

[GD Lounge # Reforged\_Insanity :)](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/gd-lounge-reforgedinsanity/440796/19813)

[Bluspacecow-muradin](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Bluspacecow-muradin) (Bluspacecow) December 1, 2020, 8:21am 2

@Addon users

Bear this in mind when browsing addons. If an addon author hasn’t opted in their addon may be marked as abandoned.

If you do see that message the addon may not necessarily be abandoned. You could try to contact the addon author and direct them to the form above to unflag their addon. Feel free to refer them to this thread if you like.

[Bluspacecow-muradin](https://us.forums.blizzard.
com/en/wow/u/Bluspacecow-muradin) (Bluspacecow) December 8, 2020, 6:50pm 3

An update to this -

From the Curseforge discord -  
" Accounts that have gone missing over the transfer never opted into the transfer as required. <https://account-transfer.curseforge.com/> You can transfer it here!

Will be active on the website after you logout and back in again."

[Elvenbane-veknilash](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Elvenbane-veknilash) (Elvenbane) December 8, 2020, 6:54pm 4

Do you know if abandoned projects can be picked up by new authors?

[Ketho-boulderfist](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Ketho-boulderfist) December 8, 2020, 9:13pm 5

No, it depends on the license and that only allows for making new projects with the same code
